title: Fix booking submission and admin notification flow end-to-end

requirements.summary: Audit and fix the booking form submission pipeline end-to-end, ensuring field type alignment between frontend and backend, proper error handling, and booking ID return on success
acceptanceCriteria: Filling out all booking form fields and clicking Submit successfully stores a new booking in the backend without throwing an error.
The backend createBooking function accepts all current fields including preferredTime.
The frontend useCreateBooking mutation correctly maps form state to the backend call arguments.
A successful submission returns a booking ID and displays the confirmation message with the booking ID.
A failed submission displays the user-friendly error message.

file_operations.description: Review and fix the booking form submission logic to ensure all fields (serviceType, category as bookingCategory, name as customerName, phone as phoneNumber, preferredDate, preferredTime, optional message) are correctly serialized and passed to the useCreateBooking mutation. Ensure the form maps serviceType and category enums correctly to match the backend BookingRequest interface. Verify that on mutation success, the booking ID from the returned Booking object is extracted and displayed in the confirmation screen. On mutation failure, display 'Booking failed. Please check your details and try again.' Ensure the confirmation screen only appears after a successful mutation with a valid booking ID.

requirements.summary: Ensure the post-submission confirmation screen displays prominent WhatsApp and Email notification buttons with all booking details, visible only after successful submission
acceptanceCriteria: After a successful form submission, the WhatsApp notification button is visible and links to 'https://wa.me/918689838590?text=...' with all booking details URL-encoded.
After a successful form submission, the email notification button is visible and opens a pre-filled mailto link to ptripathy1989@gmail.com with correct subject and body.
Both buttons are hidden or absent before submission or on submission failure.
The booking ID returned from the backend is present in both the WhatsApp message text and the email body.
The WhatsApp message text starts with 'New Booking from Website'.

file_operations.description: Audit and fix the confirmation screen that appears after successful booking submission. Ensure that both the WhatsApp and Email notification buttons are prominently displayed only when the mutation succeeds and a valid booking ID is returned. The WhatsApp button must link to 'https://wa.me/918689838590?text=<urlencoded message>' where the message starts with 'New Booking from Website' and includes: booking ID, customer name (customerName), phone (phoneNumber), service type (serviceType enum label), booking category (category enum label), preferred date, preferred time, and optional message. The Email button must open a mailto link to ptripathy1989@gmail.com with subject 'New Booking – Omm Vedic Numerloggy' and body containing all the same booking details in a readable format. Verify both links correctly interpolate the booking ID and all form fields. Ensure these buttons do not appear before submission or on failure.

requirements.summary: Audit the useCreateBooking hook to ensure it correctly calls the backend actor's createBooking method, unwraps the Result variant, and surfaces errors to React Query state
acceptanceCriteria: The useCreateBooking hook returns the created booking record (with ID) in the mutation's data on success.
The useCreateBooking hook throws or rejects with an error message when the backend returns an #err variant.
BookingForm.tsx correctly reads the booking ID from the mutation result to display in the confirmation screen.
BookingForm.tsx correctly detects mutation failure and shows the error message.

file_operations.description: Audit the useCreateBooking mutation hook to confirm it correctly calls actor.createBooking with a BookingRequest object matching the backend interface (customerName, phoneNumber, serviceType enum, category as bookingCategory enum, preferredDate, preferredTime, optional message). Ensure the hook checks the returned Result variant: if the result is { __kind__: 'ok', ok: Booking }, return the Booking object; if { __kind__: 'err', err: BookingError }, throw a user-friendly error (e.g., 'Booking failed. Please check your details and try again.') so React Query's onError and isError states are triggered correctly. Verify the mutation invalidates the ['bookings'] query key on success to refresh the bookings list.
